## Foggy Fleece

[![Foggy Fleece in *Sonic Rainboom* — production screencap](https://vignette2.wikia.nocookie.net/mlp/images/f/f2/Foggy_Fleece_ID_S1E16.png/revision/latest?cb=20160119230951)](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/File:Foggy_Fleece_ID_S1E16.png)

*Image: **My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic** production screencap (Hasbro/Studio B); file attribution and metadata at the linked image page.*

Foggy Fleece is an elderly pegasus who works at Cloudsdale’s weather factory. Look for her pale blue-white coat, white mane and tail, and purple ball-of-yarn cutie mark. Her eyes appear light blue in season one but orange in later shots. She is a recurring minor character, not a disguised major pony. [Character guide](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Foggy_Fleece).

**Naming:** She is not named aloud in the series. Licensed Enterplay merchandise names her **“Foggy Fleece, Cloud Crafter”** on *Canterlot Nights* card #71 (common), distinguishing the merchandise identification from television dialogue. A card anecdote says she resisted a proposed retirement party and returned to work. [Card catalog](https://data.mlpmerch.com/ccg/all/).

**Speaking:** Yes—one identified English line in *Sonic Rainboom*: “Yeah! I could watch you fly all day long!” Her voice is attributed to **Kathleen Barr** in [episode cast listings](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt1850770/fullcredits/); the [episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Sonic_Rainboom) identifies Foggy as the speaker.

**Appearances:** *Sonic Rainboom* (S1E16, weather factory); *Leap of Faith* (S4E20, at Flim and Flam’s tonic demonstration with both wings bandaged); *Equestria Games* (S4E24, brief spectator appearance). These appearances belong to the G4 *Friendship Is Magic* television continuity.

## Important moments

1. **Cheers on Rarity’s new wings** — *Sonic Rainboom* (S1E16). Her enthusiastic encouragement helps persuade Rarity to enter the Best Young Flyer Competition, worsening Rainbow Dash’s nerves. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=l82yvb2_gqk) — scene timestamp unavailable.
2. **Appears among the injured at the tonic pitch** — *Leap of Faith* (S4E20). Her bandaged wings make her an identifiable attendee at Flim and Flam’s questionable cure demonstration; the episode does not establish that she is cured. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Tth1HHEJNRQ) — scene timestamp unavailable.

No other character-defining dialogue or decisions were verified; her *Equestria Games* appearance is a background cameo.
